parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment explicitly states two possible actions: either "an expanded (and separate) discussion and analysis on the alpha schedule" or "its removal from the paper." These are direct suggestions. The two options presented are concrete, identifiable courses of action: authors can either delete the alpha schedule content from the paper or add a separate, expanded discussion and analysis of it. The rubric for the highest score requires an explicit action with concrete details on how to implement it, and stating two clear alternative actions (expand it with a separate discussion or remove it) qualifies as concrete enough for authors to know exactly what to do. Expecting the reviewer to specify every granular aspect of the new discussion would impose an unsupported standard of detail beyond what the rubric requires. The authors are thus given two precise, mutually exclusive options for handling the alpha schedule content, constituting explicit and concrete guidance on how to apply the actions.
